# Where Altjira works now: the myths behind the markets

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Altjira** works now.

The mythology of Altjira comes to us through Arrernte oral tradition and the early ethnographies of Spencer and Gillen, Carl Strehlow, and later scholars. The stories are not entertainment; they are title deeds to country, instructions for ceremony, and maps of moral responsibility. Some details are held by initiated custodians and are not shared in public space.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **6 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Altjira
- **Pantheon:** Aboriginal
- **Domain of influence:** The Dreaming, Eternal
- **Pattern seats:** 6
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Environmental & Climate Services
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 17 of 463

## The Myth at Work

**The Uncreated Creator.** In the account recorded by Spencer and Gillen, Altjira is eternal: he was not born and will not die.  In the beginning he made the earth and all that it contains — its hills, waterholes, plants, and animals — and then he rose into the sky, where he remains with his two sons. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**The Sky Above.** Altjira lives in the sky, high above the camps of men and women.  His feet are like the feet of the emu, and he never bends them, because the sky is wide and there is no obstacle in his path. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Environmental & Climate Services

*Climate science, ecology, and sustainability consulting. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Canonical altjira resonance — environment climate* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Education, Research & Knowledge

*Schools, universities, and research institutions. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Canonical altjira resonance — education* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations

*Religious institutions, faith media, and devotional services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*Canonical altjira resonance — faith* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Altjira performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Music, Arts & Performance

*Music, theatre, dance, and the performing arts. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Canonical altjira resonance — music arts* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Altjira performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Writing, Publishing & Media

*Canonical altjira resonance — publishing media* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Altjira performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

The temple holds 1 further seat beyond these — the full, argued list lives on its [patterns floor](/altjira/patterns/).

## The Long Employment

The word Alcheringa — the Dreaming — has become one of the most widely recognised Aboriginal English terms in the world.  It names not only a cosmology but a legal, artistic, and environmental framework that continues to shape Aboriginal identity in Central Australia and beyond. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

The atlas is not a horoscope. Seats are earned from the sources — argued, weighted, published — and every one of them can be challenged at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). A match that cannot survive an argument does not survive review. That is the whole trick: the patterns are claims, and claims can be tested.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in environmental & climate services, education, research & knowledge, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/altjira/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
